description: The price of testing an idea with ten days of real ads, before anything is paid. One payment in USDC on Base: a $29 launch fee for the idea (DECA makes the brand, the landing page, the ads and a film, runs them and reads the result; no subscription) plus the ad budget you pick, at cost. Each option's total_usd is what start_test charges. The budget is sized to the idea: several options (signal, clear read, market comparison, or your own budget), each with its expected visits, the number of confirmed sign-ups it must reach to pass, and what it can and cannot tell. Use an idea_id from get_ideas or describe your own idea. The quote is valid for 30 minutes. Free; nothing is charged.

budget_usd.description: A budget of your own to price alongside the options, between 250 and 2000. Optional.

idea.description: Your own idea, when it is not from get_ideas. It is never published.

pitch.description: Who it is for and what it does for them, in a few sentences.

markets.description: Where the ads run. Default: US, GB, CA.
